_comment: Fan-list series → the Marvel Comics app's name for it, for series the app renamed. Key it with the series' start year, "Name (Year)", because names get reused (the app's "X-Men (2013)" is a different book from Uncanny X-Men (2013)). comics-import tries the app's name first, then the list's. Add a line when the importer can't find a series you know the app has.
